about.title: About Me
about.text: Tech lead based in Braga, Portugal, working remotely. At a B2B pharmaceutical startup I stepped up to lead the team within 6 months, grew it from 4 to ~10 engineers and introduced CI/CD and Terraform, taking releases from 2–4 hours to under 20 minutes. At a large e-commerce I led the zero-downtime migration of a legacy PHP monolith into Node.js microservices with RabbitMQ. I still code every day with FastAPI, Symfony, Laravel and TypeScript, mentor developers and lead incident response on AWS and Kubernetes.
